SYNTHESIZED — no real Pi agent transcript was available on this machine.

This fixture mimics the real native record structure of
`<data_dir>/.pi/agent/sessions/<cwd-slug>/<session>.jsonl` as written by Pi
(one JSON object per line; every record carries `type`, `id`, `parentId`, an
ISO-8601 `timestamp`, and `runtime.version`, except `title`, which carries
`updatedAt`). Field names follow the public Pi session format
(https://pi.dev/docs/latest/session-format and badlogic/pi-mono
`session-manager.ts`); session ids, token counts, and prose are invented.
It is not a captured production transcript.
